status: Implementation and compile-only checks; mathematical/operator/numerical validation deferred to the unified checkpoint.
precision: RadiationReal=GpuReal; float in FP32, double in FP64.
single_scalar_arrays: Mie host table/interpolation and GPU table/query/result
all optical coefficients and phase scaling/errors
physical intensities and frozen physical snapshot
removed_fp32: particle enthalpy carry in radiation response
retained_independent_state: frozen values are an angular iteration snapshot; source, residual and material exchange channels have separate physical/algorithmic meanings, not low-part carries.

schedule.dependencies: Consecutive narrow levels synchronize within one CTA; wide levels retain original graph nodes. Same schedule for both precisions.

fp64_interface_boundaries: OpenFOAM scalar input/output and host vectors
host time interval until material kernel entry
residual: Residual is evaluated with the actual scalar equation and actual single stored field. A changed relaxed field is remeasured; unit relaxation reuses its identical solved-field residual.
history: Checkpoint-02 compensation fixtures remain unchanged in their original path.

thresholds.epsilon: numeric_limits<RadiationReal>::epsilon(); float epsilon in FP32 and original double epsilon in FP64.

linear_tolerance.normalization: max_cell(abs(diagonal*I-source +/- ordered incoming flux*I)) / max(small,abs(diagonal*I),abs(source),abs(outgoing internal face flux*I))

phase_tolerance.normalization: row: abs(sum_j P_ij-1); column: abs(sum_j w_j*P_ji-w_i)/abs(w_i). Ordered sums retain direction order.

thresholds.negative_intensity_roundoff: Existing factor 256*epsilon*max(1,abs(reference)); epsilon follows scalar type.
thresholds.material_relative_tolerance: FP32 temperature max(requested 1e-10,8*epsilon), energy max(requested 1e-9,32*epsilon); FP64 unchanged.
thresholds.material_roundoff: Existing 4096*epsilon multiplier in conservative boundary scale and implicit material absolute energy allowance; scale expressions unchanged.
thresholds.caloric_response: Existing 64*epsilon*max(abs(exchange),abs(source)); retain max 256 iterations and representable interval termination.
thresholds.normalizer_minimum: numeric_limits<RadiationReal>::min() replaces unrepresentable double minimum only in FP32.
thresholds.interpretation: Preset arithmetic resolution choices only; not validated physical accuracy and never a residual replacement.

acceptance.status: Frozen before all numerical runs. Both old and new diagnostics are printed. Passing the new bound alone is not a physical accuracy claim.
acceptance.near_equilibrium_gross: P_gross=abs(kappa_a)*(sum_a abs(w_a*I_a)+4*pi*abs(B(T_particle))), units W/m^3. Diagnostic arithmetic is host double and never feeds the solver.
acceptance.near_equilibrium_new_bound: B_selected=B_old+c_selected*P_gross. Print actual absolute error, old bound, selected bound, old acceptance, P_actual, P_analytic, input deltaT and RadiationReal-quantized deltaT.
acceptance.temperature_cases: deltaT in {0,+1e-6,-1e-6,+1,-1} K and existing nextafter(float(1000),+infinity) resident input. For abs(P_analytic)>B_selected, computed power must have the same sign.
acceptance.local_closure_gross_radiative: V*P_gross plus sum_boundary,angle abs(A*w*cosine*I_boundary) plus sum_internal,angle abs(w*F*I_upwind). Incoming boundary intensity is reconstructed by the fixture from the specified boundary model and input snapshot.
acceptance.local_closure_bound: 2e-5*max(1 W,gross_net)+c_selected*gross_radiative. Print absolute cell closure W and old net-normalized closure.
acceptance.global_closure: sum_cells(P*V)+sum_boundary(A*q); internal faces cancel in this net. Bound is 2e-5*max(1 W,sum_cells abs(P*V)+sum_boundary abs(A*q))+c_selected*sum_cells(gross_radiative). Internal faces contribute twice to the conservative global gross observation.
acceptance.global_output: global signed closure W, old/new bound W, old acceptance, total gross radiative W, sum of absolute external net boundary powers W, sum of external angular magnitude W, abs(global closure)/external net magnitude, and a declared one-second observation window giving closure J/gross radiative J and their ratio.
acceptance.total_energy_scope: The stationary fixture has no material inventory or elapsed simulation step. Its declared one-second conversion is diagnostic, not stored material energy. Actual total energy/inventory comparison belongs to the integrated baseline/new64/new32 0.295-to-0.305 checkpoint.
acceptance.near_zero_caveat: Large gross radiative exchange with small net power can yield very large relative net-power error even within the selected absolute bound. All raw fields, old bounds and actual errors remain visible; do not hide this loss of resolution.
acceptance.ordered_fixture: All scalar equation coefficients/state/residual are RadiationReal. Compare reported residual to independently ordered CPU same-scalar residual within 8*epsilon relative to the larger residual; solution error <= max(128*epsilon,8*measured_target)*max(1,max|known solution|). These are preset fixture bounds, pending execution.
